title: Segmented scan via warp shuffle (CUDA)
info: Real CUDA-C compiled by arena.cuda_c.CudaProgram, executed on arena.cuda_sim.GPU.
32 elements (one warp), 8 segments marked by head_flag (element 0 is always a head).
__shfl_up_sync must be the whole right-hand side of its own assignment -- read val_up/flag_up into their own variables each step.
